name: AXM Branch Module Return Gate
actions: inspect one explicitly selected branch module folder without executing it
refuse external packages, remote runtime services, native host components, escaping imports and undeclared files
emit a deterministic axm.modular-piece-package/v1 envelope for the existing governed modular-intake route
verify file and package digests before review
summary: A one-way portability valve that lets specialized AXM branches propose self-contained modules without making the Workshop depend on those branches.
notes: TEST material. Passing this gate means structurally portable and ready for governed review, not installed, promoted, runtime-proven, visually approved or CANON.
